name: Trailer-Mounted Nitrogen Pump Unit
summary: High-performance trailer-mounted nitrogen pump/converter unit with an integrated 2,000 US Gallon liquid nitrogen storage tank for demanding oilfield applications.
description: The trailer-mounted design provides easy transportation, rapid mobilization, and operational flexibility, while the integrated 2,000 US Gallon nitrogen tank allows for efficient on-site nitrogen supply during operations.
specs: Liquid nitrogen tank capacity: 2,000 US Gallon
Nitrogen gas output: up to 180,000 SCF/hr
Maximum working pressure: up to 15,000 PSI
Available pressure ratings: 10,000 PSI (690 bar) and 14,500 PSI (1,000 bar)
Hazardous area certification: Zone II (additional certifications available on request)
Applications: well stimulation, pressure testing, nitrogen lifting, well intervention, and other oilfield operations
imageAlt: MBF trailer-mounted nitrogen pump unit with liquid nitrogen storage tank
